title: Impulse Buy trigger-close lateness and price-chase sensitivity

frozenCohort.statusAndBasisDataSource: frozen cohort export only; no current status, cancellation, or entry value refreshed

capturedVersusReconstructed.reconstructionSource: public BingX swap historical kline endpoint; exact symbol and exact anchor time
capturedVersusReconstructed.localCacheReview: The existing local BingX acquisition artifacts in this report area are 1h bars; they cannot substitute for the exact 30m trigger candle and were not used for trigger-close reconstruction.
capturedVersusReconstructed.triggerCloseTimestampSemantics: Code check: scanner.ts selects the latest 30m candle only when candle.time + 30 minutes <= scan time, then persists candleClosedAt = candle.time + 30 minutes (scanner.ts 7165-7168, 7585-7589). The saved timestamp is candle CLOSE time, not open time.
capturedVersusReconstructed.priceChaseDefinition: ((frozen_basis_entry_price / exact BingX 30m trigger candle close) - 1) * 100; original_entry_price is preferred, and frozen entry_price fallback is separately labeled
capturedVersusReconstructed.unknownHandling: No captured trigger identity means unknown; no latest-bar or favorable-bar inference. Unknown delay and price-chase rows fail open and remain in the full retained cohort.
capturedVersusReconstructed.futurePivotConfirmations: No pivots are computed or used in this delay/chase analysis; no future pivot confirmation enters either feature.
capturedVersusReconstructed.snapshotMetricsInput: Read-only production SELECT by frozen decision_snapshot_id; status columns were not selected. Returned snapshot fields are cross-checked against the frozen cohort and identified as captured only from immutable snapshot provenance.

metricsCoverage.cutoffUnknownsAreNotTreatedAsPassOrFail: Unknown telemetry is explicitly fail-open for all full-cohort removal counts.

predeclaredCuts.rule: Strictly greater than only; no threshold is selected or tuned after observing outcomes.
predeclaredCuts.delayCaveat: The fixed >5-minute delay cut is not a proposed helpful gate: almost every measured signal exceeds it because the scanner naturally runs after a 30m candle closes.

sourceSemantics.hit_times: 15m bar open and bar close are approximate threshold times; same-bar target/stop overlaps are explicitly flagged
sourceSemantics.coverage_rule: all expected aligned buckets from ceil(entry,15m) through floor(entry+horizon,15m)-15m; valid OHLC; zero invalid or duplicate bars; exact endpoints
sourceSemantics.preclose_rule: separate tracker closed_at-bounded path for non-cancelled closed rows; not evidence of a fill
sourceSemantics.closed_bar_filter: open >= detected_at; open + 15m <= horizon endpoint and capture asof

dateCutSensitivity.interpretation: Fixed sensitivity split only: detected_at before 2026-09-20 00:00 UTC versus on/after. It does not redefine a selected cutoff.

currentSingleEntrySensitivity.missingOrOtherPolicyRowsRemainDistinct: Rows are not assigned to single_entry_v1 by date or by current code; only the frozen explicit entry_policy_version is used.

limitations: This retrospective fired cohort is not a live-gate test and does not estimate rejected counterfactuals.
Final tracked statuses and OHLC observations do not prove exchange executions or prospective improvement.
Trigger close OHLC is reconstructed from public historical BingX data after the event, not captured in the immutable snapshot.
The snapshot entry_price fallback is not relabeled as original_entry_price or as a verified fill.
An observed +5%/+10% candle high is an OHLC path hit, not an executed take-profit.
No stop thresholds, volume/taker/Price24/BTC indicators, or pivots were re-audited or optimized here.
